systems.name: TerrainSys
systems.summary: Records marching cubes compute dispatches for up to 8 pending chunks per frame, owns the per-slot GPU vertex buffers and indirect draw commands, and destroys chunk entities marked ChunkDestroying.

systems.name: TerrainPass
systems.lane: per-frame call from Renderer::render (record on a taskflow worker, once per render target)
systems.summary: Draws every ChunkGPU + ChunkReady chunk with an indirect draw, triplanar grass/rock texturing.

systems.name: GrassPass
systems.lane: per-frame call from Renderer::render (record on a taskflow worker, once per render target)
systems.summary: Redraws the chunk meshes lifted by the grass height with the raymarched grass shader, parameters from RenderSettings::grass_params.

systems.name: ModelPass
systems.lane: per-frame call from Renderer::render (update on main thread, record on a taskflow worker)
systems.summary: Creates material descriptor sets of new ModelC entries, then draws every Transform + ModelRenderable entity with the ModelC it points to.

systems.name: UIPass
systems.lane: per-frame call from Renderer::render (update on main thread, record on a taskflow worker, desktop only)
systems.summary: Calls ImGui::Render, copies the draw lists into per-frame mapped buffers and draws them on the desktop target; touches no registry state.

systems.name: Renderer
systems.lane: per-frame call from Game::start (prepare before systems, render after them)
systems.summary: Owns the Vulkan/OpenXR Context, both render targets and the scene passes; emplaces ModelManager, RenderSettings and Context*; per frame waits the fence, chains transfer -> compute -> graphics and records both targets in parallel.

systems.name: ClassicRender
systems.summary: Desktop render target: acquires the swapchain image unless the window is hidden, writes the ViewUBO from the Camera, records the passes, presents, optional frame capture.

systems.name: VRRender
systems.summary: Headset render target: emplaces VRRig, polls OpenXR session events into VRInput, runs xrWaitFrame/xrBeginFrame/xrEndFrame, writes per-eye ViewUBOs from VRRig and located views.

systems.name: VRActions
systems.summary: Emplaces VRInput and, every VR frame, writes head pose and per-hand controller state (pose, velocity, trigger, grip, thumbstick, primary button with rising edges) into it.

systems.name: ModelManager
systems.lane: on demand (called by systems and the ModelRenderable scene component)
systems.summary: Context variable that loads a glTF file (or a code-built MeshData) once, creates one entity holding its ModelC and caches it by path/key.

components.name: ChunkGPU
components.summary: GPU mesh slot of a chunk entity: index into TerrainBuffers::vertices and the indirect draw buffer.
components.description: Emplaced (emplace_or_replace) by TerrainSys::tick on a chunk entity in the same frame its marching cubes dispatch is recorded. `slot` indexes TerrainBuffers::vertices and the indirect command at offset slot * TerrainBuffers::indirect_stride. When a chunk is re-meshed its previous slot is queued for reuse and replaced by a new one; when the chunk entity is destroyed (ChunkDestroying) its slot is queued too. Queued slots return to the free list only after more than NUM_FRAMES + 1 (= 4) TerrainSys ticks, so frames in flight never see a recycled buffer. Slots are in [0, TerrainSys::max_slots = 2048). TerrainSys::init creates the storage up front so the passes can view it from worker threads; TerrainSys's destructor clears it. Read by TerrainPass and GrassPass (together with ChunkReady).

fields.name: slot
fields.desc: Mesh slot index, < 2048.

components.name: ChunkReady
components.summary: The chunk's mesh was recorded into a compute batch submitted before this frame's graphics, so it is drawable.
components.description: Empty struct emplaced (emplace_or_replace) by TerrainSys::tick together with ChunkGPU, in the same tick the dispatch is recorded; the graphics submit of the same frame waits on the compute semaphore, so the mesh is drawable immediately. Never removed individually: it disappears with the chunk entity or when TerrainSys's destructor clears the storage. TerrainPass and GrassPass draw only entities with both ChunkGPU and ChunkReady; the debug menu counts ChunkReady entities as 'meshed'.

components.name: TerrainBuffers
components.summary: Context variable exposing TerrainSys's indirect draw buffer and per-slot vertex buffers to the terrain and grass passes.
components.description: Emplaced by TerrainSys::init (indirect and indirect_stride set there; vertices empty). TerrainSys::allocateSlot appends the vertex buffer of each newly created slot, so vertices.size() equals the number of slots ever allocated and is indexed by ChunkGPU::slot. Handles are non-owning copies: the VmaBuffers live in TerrainSys. indirect holds max_slots (2048) vk::DrawIndirectCommand entries at indirect_stride (sizeof(DrawIndirectCommand) = 16 rounded up to max(minStorageBufferOffsetAlignment, 16)). Each vertex buffer holds max_triangles * 3 = 98304 TerrainVertex (32 bytes). Erased by TerrainSys's destructor. The passes use reg.ctx().find and skip drawing when it is absent (scene without the Terrain system).

fields.name: indirect
fields.desc: Indirect draw commands, one per slot (storage | indirect | transfer dst, GPU only).

fields.name: indirect_stride
fields.desc: Byte stride between slots in indirect.

fields.name: vertices
fields.desc: Vertex buffer of each slot, indexed by ChunkGPU::slot.

components.name: ModelC
components.summary: GPU mesh of one loaded glTF file (or code-built mesh), on its own entity; instances reference it through ModelRenderable::model.
components.description: Created only by ModelManager::load (from loadGLTF) and ModelManager::add, each on a fresh entity that holds nothing else. Vertices/indices are uploaded through Transfer::createBuffer (on a dedicated GPU a staging copy recorded in the transfer command buffer; ready after the transfer fence), with all glTF node transforms of the default scene baked in, so one ModelC is one vertex buffer + one uint32 index buffer split into parts by material. materials always ends with a default material (white, untextured) for primitives without one. Material::set starts null and is filled by ModelPass::update on the main thread; parts whose material has no set are skipped when drawing. min/max are the model-space bounds of all vertices. Read by ModelPass and by base_scene / world_view code (bounds). Renderer::finish removes every ModelC (reg.clear<ModelC>) before the device is destroyed; the entities themselves are not destroyed.

fields.name: vertices
fields.desc: ModelVertex buffer (position, normal, uv: 32 bytes each).

fields.name: indices
fields.desc: uint32 index buffer, triangles; winding flipped for negative-determinant node transforms.

fields.name: parts
fields.desc: Draw ranges: first_index, index_count (multiple of 3), material index.

fields.name: materials
fields.desc: base_color (vec4, default 1), image (shared_ptr<VmaImage>, null = white), set (vk::DescriptorSet, filled by ModelPass).

fields.name: min
fields.desc: Model-space bounding box minimum.

fields.name: max
fields.desc: Model-space bounding box maximum.

components.name: ModelManager
components.summary: Context variable caching loaded models: path (or key) -> entity holding the ModelC.
components.description: Emplaced by the Renderer constructor, so it exists only in rendered runs (the ModelRenderable scene component throws 'ModelRenderable needs the renderer' without it). load(path) returns the cached entity or loads the glTF/GLB file, creating one entity with a ModelC; on failure logs an error and returns entt::null (the entity created before loading is left behind without components). add(key, MeshData) builds a single-material white mesh from code and caches it under key. get(path) only looks up the cache. Paths are used verbatim as cache keys (callers prefix ./resources/). Erased by Renderer::finish.

fields.name: reg
fields.desc: Host registry the model entities are created in.

fields.name: models
fields.desc: Cache, private.

components.name: Context*
components.summary: Pointer to the renderer's Vulkan/OpenXR Context (VRContext, Windu, Instance, Device + VMA, Transfer, Compute, Swapchain, view descriptor layout, frame index).
components.description: Emplaced as reg.ctx().emplace<Context*>(this) in the Context constructor (inside the Renderer constructor), after every member is built and before VRContext::init. The Context object is a member of Renderer, so the pointer is valid from Renderer construction until Renderer destruction; it is never erased from the context. Systems that need GPU access (TerrainSys, InputSys, ModelManager, loadGLTF) fetch it with *reg.ctx().get<Context*>(). Members are constructed in order vr, win, instance, device, transfer, compute, swap. frame_index cycles 0..NUM_FRAMES-1 (NUM_FRAMES = 3) and is advanced by Renderer::prepare.

fields.name: vr
fields.desc: OpenXR instance/session/space/per-eye swapchains; enabled() false when vr_mode is 0 or no runtime/headset.

fields.name: win
fields.desc: SDL2 window and VkSurfaceKHR.

fields.name: instance
fields.desc: vk::Instance (API 1.1 or what OpenXR requires), debug messenger in debug builds.

fields.name: device
fields.desc: Physical/logical device, queues (all on the graphics family), VmaAllocator.

fields.name: transfer
fields.desc: Upload command buffer, staging buffers, createImage/createBuffer.

fields.name: compute
fields.desc: Ring of NUM_FRAMES compute command buffers.

fields.name: swap
fields.desc: Desktop swapchain, images and views.

fields.name: view_layout
fields.desc: Set 0 of every scene pipeline: one uniform buffer (ViewUBO), vertex + fragment.

fields.name: frame_index
fields.desc: Current frame in flight, 0..NUM_FRAMES-1.
